name: APC membrane recruitment protein 1
pathways: positive regulation of protein catabolic process

function.text: AMER1 encodes APC membrane recruitment protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein-membrane adaptor activity and beta-catenin binding. It participates in positive regulation of protein ubiquitination and positive regulation of protein catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Wilms tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: AMER1 encodes APC membrane recruitment protein 1. It is a regulator of the canonical Wnt signaling pathway. It acts by specifically binding phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2), translocating to the cell membrane and interacting with key regulators of the canonical Wnt signaling pathway, such as components of the beta-catenin destruction complex. It acts both as a positive and negative regulator of the Wnt signaling pathway, depending on the context: acts as a positive regulator by promoting LRP6 phosphorylation.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis (x-linked).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AMER1 have been reported in Wilms tumor, colon adenocarcinoma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.
